title: Covered buildings and structures.

blocks.html:
Such buildings or structures include:

1.new construction;

2.substantial improvements;

3.such portions of buildings or structures that are horizontal enlargements.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
